nodes.label: AMPM Platform — Your Flowcharts, Redrawn With the Gaps Filled
nodes.rationale: Reproduces AMPM's two Level-1 flowcharts and the Why-note customer journey faithfully, then shows an upgraded version with every box colour-coded (grey unchanged, green added, amber changed) and tagged with the finding it answers, so AMPM can see at a glance what was theirs, what filled a gap and what changed. Status: proposal, nothing approved.

nodes.label: Colour legend: grey unchanged, green added (+ ID), amber changed (~ ID)
nodes.rationale: Tags name the finding a box answers: CF conflict, GP gap, AM ambiguity, Q decision, A/U/W assumption.

nodes.label: AMPM Team App Level-1 flowchart (as supplied)
nodes.rationale: Five tabs and one linear path from a qualified client to closure. The stages after the wedding record is created match the specification and are kept; it omits everything before a wedding record exists: subscription, demo, hotel work, and a place for the Hotel and RSVP teams (CF-3, CF-4).

nodes.label: Upgraded team app flowchart
nodes.rationale: Adds staff sign-in, the nine desktop areas with Hotels and Guests, and the pre-project branch (demo, subscription, hotel discovery, engage decision) so the specification's critical rule is visible in the structure.

nodes.label: AMPM Client Portal Level-1 flowchart (as supplied)
nodes.rationale: The approve-or-request loop at the bottom is exactly how the portal should behave and is kept. It omits hotel discovery (CF-2), its countdown assumes every client has a wedding date, 'messages, questions' implies chat (GP-15) and 'invoices and payment status' commits to showing money the specification leaves undecided (CF-6).

nodes.label: Upgraded client portal flowchart
nodes.rationale: Adds an account-state gate with three home pages, a Hotels tab for the Phase 1 product, finance only for permitted users, and typed tracked requests in place of messages.

nodes.label: Customer journey as described in the Why AMPM App note (Stages 1-5)
Upgraded customer journey
nodes.rationale: Inserts hotel discovery and assistance and an engage decision between subscription and project, keeps non-engaging clients as subscribers with nothing deleted, and ends with closure.

nodes.label: Guest RSVP flow as specified (specification section 2.5)
Upgraded guest RSVP flow
nodes.rationale: Loads the guest list first, sends one private link per household, states a privacy notice, counts attendance per person per function, collects meal preference, restricts identity documents, and pushes every change to headcounts, menus, rooms and transport.

nodes.label: Five navigation tabs: HOME, CLIENTS, WEDDINGS, TASKS, MORE
nodes.rationale: Kept on phones in the upgraded design (W-2).

nodes.label: Nine desktop areas (Home, Leads and Clients, Hotels, Weddings, Guests, Vendors, Tasks and Operations, Finance and Reports, Settings)
nodes.rationale: Shown on desktop so Hotels and Guests have a home (CF-3, W-2; wireframes §2).

nodes.label: HOME dashboard: today, alerts, pending approvals, overdue tasks, live weddings
LEADS AND CLIENTS area
nodes.rationale: Pipeline, consultation and questionnaire as logged activities on the lead, accounts, subscriptions and agreements (CF-8, W-12; wireframes TW-10 to TW-15).

nodes.label: HOTELS area
nodes.rationale: New area for the private database: destinations, profiles, rate cards with verification dates, enquiries, site visits and proposals (CF-3, GP-8; wireframes TW-20 to TW-28; data model modules C and D).

nodes.label: WEDDINGS area: project dashboard, functions, budget, vendors, designs, approvals, requests, closure
GUESTS area
nodes.rationale: New area for cross-wedding guest operations by the RSVP team: guest database, RSVP calls, rooming, travel, support requests (CF-3; wireframes TW-50 to TW-58).

nodes.label: VENDORS area: master list, availability, quotes, contracts, deliverables
TASKS AND OPERATIONS area: tasks, staffing, run-of-show, readiness, incidents, event-day console
FINANCE AND REPORTS area: payments, invoices, milestones, reports, final accounts
SETTINGS area
nodes.rationale: Users, roles, plans and packages, reference data, templates, configuration, audit log and website content, so prices and rules are never in code (GP-3, GP-23; wireframes TW-90 to TW-97).

nodes.label: Staff sign-in: email, password and an authenticator code
nodes.rationale: GP-31/Q13; no self-registration anywhere (wireframes AUTH-01 to AUTH-05; permission matrix P-6).

nodes.label: Demo or trial stage: granted by Sales, time-boxed, sample data, expires
nodes.rationale: A stage the Why note requires but no other document specified (GP-2, CF-1; user flows Flow 1, U-1).

nodes.label: Subscription stage: AMPM invites, client pays in the portal, modules activate
nodes.rationale: Purchase path defined (CF-5, Q2; user flows Flow 1, U-2).

nodes.label: Hotel discovery and assistance branch for the subscriber
nodes.rationale: The branch most clients take and the flowchart omitted (CF-4; user flows Flow 2); availability checks included, other services by agreement (GP-5, U-3).

nodes.label: Decision gate: engages AMPM beyond hotels?
nodes.rationale: Makes the critical rule visible: no leads to remaining a subscriber, yes to a service agreement and wedding record.

nodes.label: Stays a subscriber: renew, or expire to read-only, nothing deleted
nodes.rationale: GP-1; user flows Flow 12.

nodes.label: Create wedding record from an accepted service agreement (unique ID, scope, staff and client members)
nodes.rationale: Triggered by an accepted service agreement for anything beyond hotel help (U-6, Q10; user flows Flow 3).

nodes.label: Planning and coordination: functions, venues, design, vendors, guests, budget in parallel
Live operations: readiness gate, run-of-show readable offline, incidents, arrivals
nodes.rationale: Readiness gate and offline-readable cue sheet added (GP-34; user flows Flow 9).

nodes.label: Closure: checklist (departures, lost and found, vendor completion, final accounts), feedback, client access window, archive
nodes.rationale: AMPM's feedback and archive kept and given records; a client access window added (GP-29, A-23; user flows Flow 10).

nodes.label: Client sign-in: email and password, optional phone code
nodes.rationale: Method defined, no self-registration (Q13; wireframes AUTH-01).

nodes.label: Account state gate: subscriber only, engaged client, closed wedding
nodes.rationale: The portal has three states (GP-1; permission matrix §3; wireframes §2).

nodes.label: Subscriber home: hotel discovery (search, saved hotels, enquiries, subscription)
nodes.rationale: Hotel discovery is the home page until a wedding project exists (CF-2; wireframes CP-01).

nodes.label: Engaged client home: wedding dashboard
nodes.rationale: Countdown only when dates exist; pending decisions, milestones; budget card only for users allowed to see money (W-12, W-5; wireframes CP-20).

nodes.label: Closed wedding home: read-only until the access window ends
HOTELS tab: destinations, search, hotel detail with verified rates, compare, request assistance, enquiry tracker
nodes.rationale: New tab for the Phase 1 product (CF-2, GP-8; wireframes CP-02 to CP-11).

nodes.label: MY WEDDING tab: overview and contacts, functions, vendors, designs, invitations, guest list, RSVP progress, menus
APPROVALS tab: one inbox of decisions waiting, history
MORE tab: budget, invoices and milestones for permitted users, requests, documents, subscription, notifications
nodes.rationale: Finance shown only to permitted users; subscription management added (CF-6, W-5; wireframes CP-11, CP-24, CP-25).

nodes.label: Client action kinds: a decision, a question/change/support need, help with a hotel
Decision: approve, request revision or decline, locked to the exact version
Request with a tracked thread, in place of messages
nodes.rationale: AMPM's 'messages, questions' delivered as typed, tracked requests rather than chat (GP-15, A-20; wireframes CP-36, CP-37; user flows Flow 6).

nodes.label: Hotel assistance request becomes an enquiry the Hotel team works
nodes.rationale: GP-5; user flows Flow 2.

nodes.label: Approve-or-request loop: client acts, AMPM reviews and responds, portal updates
nodes.rationale: Kept from AMPM's flowchart as exactly how the portal should behave; the upgraded version adds notifications on update.

nodes.label: Stage 1: public website (learn, examples, request a demo or access)
Stage 5: full authorised access with client users, roles, a finance flag and approval rights
nodes.rationale: Several client users per wedding with different rights (Q5).

nodes.label: Guest list loaded first by the family or the RSVP team
nodes.rationale: Households and members are loaded before invitations go out so the link knows who is responding (GP-25, U-5; user flows Flow 7; wireframes CP-31, TW-58).

nodes.label: Short privacy notice where guest data is collected
nodes.rationale: Consent and retention stated where the data is collected (GP-40, Q17; wireframes GR-01).

nodes.label: Household allowance: accompanying members up to a number the family sets
nodes.rationale: A-7; wireframes GR-02.

nodes.label: Attendance per person per function: yes, no or maybe
Travel and accommodation if asked; identity document only when the wedding requires it, never Aadhaar
nodes.rationale: Only when the wedding needs documents for hotel check-in; deleted after checkout (GP-41, Q8; data model module N; wireframes GR-05).

nodes.label: Review and submit; confirmation with a contact route; can update until the deadline
RSVP team sees the same records; scheduled reminders, then calls recording assisted responses
nodes.rationale: Assisted entries write the same records as self-service (U-5; wireframes TW-53).

nodes.label: Attendance changes update headcounts, menus, rooms and transport automatically
nodes.rationale: GP-13; user flows Flows 7 and 8.
